title: Slovakian Kiwifruit Galette
description: A traditional Slovakian-style fruit galette filled with sweet kiwifruit, perfect for a warm dessert. This recipe showcases the simplicity of Slovakian cuisine and the natural sweetness of kiwifruit.
instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a large bowl, combine the flour, cold butter, and icing sugar. Use a pastry blender or your fingers to work the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
3. In a separate bowl, whisk together the egg and vanilla extract. Add the granulated sugar and mix until combined.
4. Add the kiwifruit to the bowl and mix until the fruit is evenly coated with the sugar mixture.
5. Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch. Transfer the dough to a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
6. Arrange the kiwifruit mixture in the center of the dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
7. Fold the edges of the dough up over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
8. Brush the tops of the dough with the beaten egg for a golden glaze.
9. Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is tender.
10. Allow the galette to cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before serving.
11. Dust with confectioners sugar before serving.
